---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
top_sluggers <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_season = min(yearID),
    last_season = max(yearID)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    active_during_steroid_era = if_else(
      last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
      "Yes",
      "No"
    )
  ) |>
  select(player, career_home_runs, active_during_steroid_era)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  top_sluggers,
  aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs),
    fill = active_during_steroid_era
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Active during steroid era",
    values = c("No" = "gray60", "Yes" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Runs Among the Top 15 Sluggers",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database; era defined as 1994-2009"
  )
```
